description: This file defines a Java class 'BitState' that manages the state of bit indices, including incrementing, resetting, and retrieving the current index.

classes.name: BitState
classes.description: A class managing bit index state with methods to increment, reset, and get the current index.

methods.name: incrementBitIndex
methods.description: Increments the bit index if the provided ConfigField indicates a bit, or resets to zero otherwise. Throws an exception if the index exceeds 31.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the bit index to zero.
